title: governments/<id>/books/<book>.yaml
description: How to read one source PDF: which layout family it uses, what each printed column means (year and figure), page ranges, the staffing schedule, and how account codes map to funds and departments. Covers today's per-book files config/*.json (City budget books and projections), config/county/*.json (County budget books), config/county/acfr/*.json (audited reports) and config/county/resolutions/*.json (budget resolutions), which move here in Phases 1 and 2. Keys starting with an underscore are comments.

^_.description: A comment for people reading the file; ignored by the scripts.

header.description: A pattern (regular expression) matched against the column's printed header words joined with spaces.

fiscal_year.description: The budget year the column's figures are for.

doc_type.description: What kind of figure the column prints (today's name for figure).

figure.description: What kind of figure the column prints (the new name for doc_type; give one of the two).

page_range.description: One page, or a [first, last] pair of PDF page numbers (inclusive).

source_doc.description: The PDF's file name, exactly as saved in the government's sources folder.

layout_family.description: Which extractor reads the book. lineitem_columns = line items in printed year columns (City books); projection_book = multi-year projections; xposition_rows = County books, amounts rebuilt from their position on the page; pde2028 = Pennsylvania school district General Fund Budget form; audited_report = annual financial report schedules; budget_resolution = an adopting budget resolution. lineitem_columns books choose how pages are read with `reading`.

status.description: draft = written or guessed by a script and not yet checked by a person; the parse step refuses it. reviewed = a person has checked every column, page range and mapping against the PDF. Not in today's config/*.json files.

source.description: text = the PDF has a text layer; ocr = scanned pages, read by OCR.

reading.description: How the family reads this book's pages. word_boxes = words with positions (text layer or OCR), assigned to columns by x-position. char_rows = characters in the order the PDF draws them (books printed from a spreadsheet whose long titles overflow into the next column), rebuilt into rows first.

note_fonts.description: char_rows books: the ends of the font names used for the explanatory notes under line items (they overlap the table rows and are attached to the line above as its description).

amount_columns.description: char_rows books: the printed amount columns, left to right, in the order the row's numbers appear.

kind.description: projection = a multi-year projections book, not a budget book (no budget year, staffing or fund balance). Default budget.

budget_year.description: The budget year the book proposes or adopts.

book_year.description: The budget year of the book (County books).

fiscal_year.description: The year an audited report covers.

years.description: Every year the book prints figures for.

entity.description: The government's name as recorded for the book (today's County files).

examples: Resolution No. 79 of 2025: the County of Lancaster's 2026 budget

document_note.description: A note about the document, for people (for example how its columns are labelled).
examples: Text-layer book. Budget column is headed '2022 PROPOSED'; kept as doc_type 'proposed'.

edition.description: Which edition of the book this is (proposed, final, adopted) and the evidence.
examples: Final (file name 'v4- FINAL', dated 2024-12-11); Resolution No. 83 of 2024 on p3.

layout.description: A plain description of where the tables are in the book (today's County files).
examples: Line items from the 'Department Account' reports: General Fund revenue pp9-11, expenditure pp12-28.

original_file_name.description: The file name the document was downloaded under, before it was renamed.

url.description: The public page where the document is published.

downloaded.description: The date the copy was downloaded (YYYY-MM-DD).

saved_from.description: The file name the document was saved from.

dated.description: The date the document carries, with where it is printed; empty when none is printed.

pdf_pages.description: How many pages the PDF has.

page_note.description: How page numbers in this file relate to the printed page numbers.
examples: All pages are PDF page numbers (the printed page number is 9-10 lower).

page.description: The page that holds the figures (one-page documents such as a resolution).

copies.description: Other documents that reprint the same page.

pages.description: Page ranges by role (for example line_items, staffing, fund_balance, summary), each a list of single pages or [first, last] pairs. New in the portable layout; today these live in the extractors or in the layout prose.

page_order.description: Pages bound in the wrong order: each [a, b] pair is read in swapped order.

dpi.description: Resolution the pages are rendered at before OCR.

fallback_rotate.description: Rotation (degrees) to try when a page reads badly upright.

clean.description: true = clean the scan (threshold, erase broken table rules) before OCR.

column_years.description: The years of the printed amount columns, left to right.

glyph_map.description: Characters the PDF's text layer garbles, mapped to what is printed.

line_items.description: The line-item tables: their columns (or several layouts of columns) and how section totals are printed.

columns.description: The printed amount columns, left to right, when the book has one layout.

header_last_line.description: A pattern matched against the last line of the column header block.

total_prefix.description: A pattern that marks a printed section total row.

inherit_header.description: true = a page with no column header uses the previous page's layout.

layouts.description: Several column layouts in one book, tried in order.

columns.description: The layout's printed amount columns, left to right.

header_last_line.description: A pattern matched against the last header line of pages in this layout.

pages_seen.description: How many pages the detect step found in this layout (drafts only).

example_page.description: One page in this layout (drafts only).

staffing.description: The staffing schedule: which (year, figure) each count/salary pair is for, and the order of fields in a row.

columns.description: One entry per printed (count, salary) pair, left to right.

row.description: The fields of a staffing row after the org and object codes, in printed order.

count_pattern.description: A pattern a position count must match (for books that print fractional FTEs).

funds.description: Org-code prefix -> fund, for funds other than the main fund. A value is a fund name, or {fund, department} when the whole fund belongs to one department.

other_fund_department.description: The department of every fund in `funds` given by name only (not as {fund, department}). Required when any such fund is listed.

general_fund_department_overrides.description: Longer org-code prefixes that belong to a different department than their first digits say.

fund_titles.description: projection_book: the fund title printed in a page heading -> the fund name used everywhere else.

scenarios.description: The printed balance columns, left to right.

department_pages.description: Adjustments for checking department pages line by line, keyed by department code.

sections.description: Only these sections of the department are on its page.

add.description: [fund letter, department] pairs folded into this department's page.

schedules.description: Audited report: the budget-vs-actual schedules, one per fund.

fund.description: The fund as the site names it.

acfr_fund.description: The fund as the report names it.

book_funds.description: The budget-book funds the schedule covers.

fund_balance_table_page.description: Audited report: PDF page of the fund balance history table.

gaap_statement_page.description: Audited report: PDF page of the governmental funds statement.

budget_to_gaap_note_page.description: Audited report: PDF page of the note reconciling budget and GAAP figures.
